epics.name: Semantic Patch Decomposition
epics.description: Reference-mesh preprocessing that decomposes a surface into semantically-labeled patches to give Voyager replication agents a structural map beyond chamfer distance. Covers the decomposition algorithm (skeleton+curvature+feature-edge hybrid), VLM labeling workflow, cached .tags.json sidecars, and per-region feedback integration.

epics.name: Project Setup
epics.description: Internal project bootstrapping

epics.name: Procedural Dungeon Generation
epics.description: 3D procedural dungeon generation foundations in the mesh DSL: vazgriz-style layout (rooms, Delaunay, MST, A* corridors), a scope system so dungeon-only nodes stay out of Daud's mesh-modeling catalog, a fly-cam viewer scene, and (later) 3D stair-aware extension plus secret-primitive library. Backs the Archipelago-inspired multi-world coop design captured in KriegEterna/web/content/essays/archipelago-dungeon-design.md.

epics.name: Player Controls & Input System
epics.description: First-person controls polish for the dungeon viewer / future game runtime: FPS mouse capture (no click-to-drag), configurable input bindings, sensitivity tuning, sprint, gamepad support. Sits alongside PROCGEN since the dungeon viewer is its first consumer, but the binding layer is general engine infrastructure.

epics.name: Crawfish Model Pipeline
